timezone: Not specified by the source; timestamps are kept timezone-naive.
coverage_definition: Expected minutes are scheduled one-minute timestamp slots from the first through last observed source timestamp, inclusive; only full calendar days can be complete. Valid coverage excludes '?' power values.
method: Sum valid Global_active_power values in kW and divide by 60.
hourly_coverage_rule: A clock-hour group is complete when at least 90% of all expected minute slots in that source clock hour have valid active-power readings. Expected slots span the inclusive first-to-last timestamp period, including timestamp gaps; incomplete group means are omitted.
hourly_time_convention: Group by the timezone-naive source timestamp clock hour; no timezone or daylight-saving adjustment is inferred.
